description.value:
Frequency once per day

You know that teamwork makes the dream work, so you delegate your task to a teammate. Choose an ally within 30 feet who can perceive you and direct them to complete a simple task, such as attacking a target, moving to a location, or using an item. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Quickened] for 1 minute and can only use this extra action to Stride, Strike, or Activate an Item. If the target of Delegate completes your direction before the beginning of your next turn, you replenish your use of this feat.
